summary: Correct tool-schema budget accounting after the frozen d8f3 replay proved that history projection density was incorrectly reused as a schema tokenizer estimate. Accept an authoritative provider/runtime schema token count when mechanically available, keep the previous conservative projection fallback otherwise, and preserve provider hard context guards, model semantic authority, convergence, Evidence semantics, and search behavior.

components.owning_subsystem: provider input-budget accounting and local tokenizer authority
components.disposition: ADMIT narrow P0-A correction: the already-routed LLM client may provide an exact provider-template tool-schema token delta. Budget calculation consumes that token count directly and records its authority source; providers without a proven tokenizer capability retain the historical conservative char-density fallback. Only local OpenAI-compatible runtimes are probed, using bounded read-only template/tokenizer endpoints with per-surface caching and fail-soft fallback.
evidence: frozen d8f3 replay audit commit 00d7d72a9c221ab644d535754fcfde6b7e33838d proved incident reserve 39,412 tokens versus exact Qwen tool-wire delta 11,324
deterministic d8f3 budget contract: exact 11,324 reserve yields 34,390 history chars instead of 9,111
synthetic exact-pressure regression preserves 15,796-char first-compaction shape and proves 9,111 compacts while 34,390 does not
same loaded local runtime probe returns 11,324 on first measurement and cached 11,324 on repeat without a generation call
components.verification_level: deterministic RED->GREEN + exact local tokenizer probe + adjacent regression + full repository CI
components.model_evidence_veto_recovery_exit: Program authority is limited to mechanical token counting and hard budget projection. It does not decide whether evidence is sufficient, whether a search should repeat, or whether the model should stop. Unknown/unavailable tokenizer authority falls back rather than fabricating an exact count; final provider context guards remain authoritative for physical limits.
components.rollback_route: Revert the P0-A commit; no persisted data migration exists. The historical projection fallback remains available within the same code path.

g1.necessity: The frozen d8f3 replay demonstrated a deterministic accounting defect: a 35,470-char 71-tool surface was reserved as 39,412 tokens by reusing 0.9 history chars/token, while the exact provider template/tokenizer delta was 11,324 tokens. That reduced history budget to 9,111 chars and directly triggered the 15,796->390 compaction that hid freshly fetched evidence.

g2.authority_owner: the already-routed provider/model LLMClient for exact local tokenizer capability, consumed by the existing RoutingService/token-budget path
g2.non_duplication: No second model-routing or context-limit authority is introduced. Exact schema tokens refine one input to the existing budget calculation; the existing projection fallback and final provider context guards remain in place.

g3.recovery_or_reason: If exact tokenizer capability is missing, remote, unsupported, malformed, or transiently unavailable, the correction fails soft to the pre-existing conservative projection path. No search/evidence/convergence semantic decision is added.

g4.rollback: Revert this commit; no state migration is required. If later deployed, runtime rollback uses the normal managed service generation path.
